articles.summary: Intrepid Potash, Inc. ("Intrepid", "the Company", "we", "us", or "our") (NYSE:IPI) today reported its results for the third quarter of 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Highlights (All comparisons versus the prior-year third quarter ended September 30, 2025) Sales of $51.0 million, in-line with the same prior year period Net income from continuing operations of $1.7 million or $0.13 per diluted share versus $0.7 million or $0.05 per diluted share Adjusted EBITDA (1) from continuing operations of $11.7 million versus $10.7 million Net cash and short-term investments of $161.4 million as of September 30, 2026 $3.0 million of shares repurchased from the beginning of the third quarter through October 31, 2026 Production volume guidance increased by 10 thousand tons for Trio ® Management Commentary “We delivered improved profitability in the third quarter, supported by higher Trio ® production volumes, pricing strength and a 33% increase in our Trio ® gross margin,” stated Kevin Crutchfield,
articles.title: Intrepid Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
